requirements.source: File 25 sections 25-28 as superseded by the 6–7 August 2026 governing addenda and current File 20 ownership boundary
requirements.summary: File 25 owns canonical colors, typography, spacing, borders, radius, shadows, component states and visual regression with Sabri Green #087A4E; File 20 retains structural widths, layout breakpoints, shell dimensions and mount geometry only.
Canonical Founder and permitted profile routes, sections, 404/410 handling and REST route parity are implemented without duplicate archives.
Founder, Doctor and permitted Member presentation, profile hero, overview sections, actions and public-view boundaries are implemented from owner assertions.
Federated read-only timeline eligibility, sorting, pinning, filters, pagination, provider contract, normalized objects and bounded indexing are implemented.
Shared public content cards, card contract, detail presentation, safe Read More behavior, knowledge gateway and profile-local discovery presentation are implemented.
Loading, empty, warning, offline, error, suspended, deleted, corrected and retracted presentation states are represented without inventing native owner decisions.

requirements.source: File 25 sections 59-61; Master Plan v3.0 P-11
requirements.summary: Mobile-first responsive CSS, keyboard semantics, focus treatment, reduced-motion support and RTL-aware component presentation are present in source.
Bounded queries, pagination, fail-closed providers, deterministic ETags, no-store user-sensitive output and graceful optional dependency degradation are implemented.
File 25 enforces secure rendering and reports bounded assurance evidence while File 24 remains the security/privacy/compliance/resilience governance owner.
Canonical titles, structured metadata, OpenGraph presentation, owner-approved public metrics and profile-completion presentation are implemented without raw analytics ownership.
Governed presentation preferences, provider declarations, dependency state and safe defaults are exposed through bounded configuration rather than foreign data mutation.
Public REST projections and reusable component APIs share strict public allow-lists and safe rendering contracts.
System checks, provider health, Safe Mode, diagnostics and bounded repair/preflight behavior are implemented without taking ownership of native data.
Schema upgrades are idempotent, plugin structure is governed, and uninstall is non-destructive by default.
Role, profile-state, timeline-state, security and accessibility source-level QA matrices are encoded across the governed test suite, including the two fresh latest-plan review rounds.
Visual-regression and browser acceptance contracts and evidence schema are implemented; real browser/device evidence is intentionally deferred.
Coding phases, deterministic ZIP, manifest, checksum, dependency matrix and independent artifact verification are implemented.

requirements.source: File 25 section 89; Master Plan v3.0 P-13 plus current File 22/23 activation gates
requirements.summary: The exact staging checklist now includes File 22 create/edit and File 23 private-management contracts, dependency versions, installed probe and rollback evidence model; Hostinger execution remains deferred.
All source-owned Definition-of-Done requirements are implemented and automated; Founder, staging, production and operational acceptance remain deliberately unclaimed.
